request.promptText: A consistent futuristic pearl-white angular electric hypercar with a black glass canopy, black multi-spoke wheels, slim white headlights and a thin red rear light strip. Cinematic photorealistic car commercial, cool teal and subtle red lighting, dark private test facility. Vertical 9:16. Moving camera and moving subject details. An elevated wide three-quarter camera tracks a controlled short descent of the car from twenty centimeters above a closed wet test road. Downward compressed-air vapor briefly cushions the descent. Tires touch the surface once, subtle suspension settling, then the car rolls forward. Keep the entire vehicle inside the frame. One continuous shot.
